WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, pursuant to Sections 93-21(a) and 93-32(a) of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York (hereinafter, the “Zoning Resolution"), the Chairperson of the City Planning Commission of the City of New York (the “CPC" Chairperson') shall allow, by certification, the distribution of Floor Area that is generated by a “granting site” located in the Phase 2 Hudson Park and Boulevard (as such terms are defined in the Zoning Resolution) to a “receiving site" located in Subarea A2 through A5 of Large Scale Plan Subdistrict A of the Special HudsonYards District (as such terms are defined in the Zoning Resolution), which distribution of floor area shall not exceed a maximum of eight (8) Floor Area Ratio ("FAR") on such receiving site; and WHEREAS, Transferor is the fee owner of that certain real property located in the County, City and State of New York, designated as Block 709, Lot 17 on the Tax Map of New York, a portion of which is located entirely within the Phase 2 Hudson Boulevard and Park of'the Special Hudson Yards District, such portion as more particularly described in Exhibit I attached hereto and made a part hereof (the “Granting Site"); and the County, City and State of New York, designated as Block 708, Lot 1 on the Tax Map of NewYork, a portion of which is located in Subarea A4 of Large Scale Plan Subdistrict . A of the Special Hudson Yards District, as more particularly described in Exhibit II attached hereto and made a part hereof (the "Receiving Site"); and WHEREAS, the Granting Site is located partially in a C6-4 zoning district and partially in a C6-2 zoning district and is located entirely within the Phase 2 Hudson Park and Boulevard of the Special Hudson Yards District; and the Zoning Resolution; and WHEREAS, the Granting Site has a lot area of twenty-five thousand fifty-five and eight tenths (25,055.8) square feet, of which twenty thousand eighty-seven and zero tenths (20,087.0) square feet is located in the underlying'C6-2 zoning district and four KL3 3020501.6

thousand nine hundred sixty-eight and eight tenths (4,968.8 square) feet is located in the underlying C6-4 zoning district; and WHEREAS, pursuant to Section 93-32 of the Zoning Resolution, the maximum FAR generated by the C6-2 portion of the Granting Site is 6.02 and the maximum FAR generated by the C6-4 portion of the Granting Site is 10.0; and WHEREAS, the Receiving Site is located in a C6-4 zoning district and in Subarea A4 of Large Scale Plan Subdistrict A of the Special Hudson Yards District; and WHEREAS, the Receiving Site is a “receiving site," as defined in Section 93-32 of the Zoning Resolution; and WHEREAS, the Receiving Site has a lot area of forty thousand eight hundred nine and forty-two hundredths (40,809.42) square feet; and WHEREAS, pursuant to Section 93-21(a)(1) of the Zoning Resolution, the Receiving Site has a basic maximum permitted FAR of ten (10), which may be increased to up to eighteen (18) by a contribution to the Hudson Yards District Improvement Fund (as such term is defined in the Zoning Resolution) pursuant to Section 93-31 of the Zoning Resolution or by the distribution of Floor Area from a “granting site” located in the Phase 2 Hudson Park and Boulevard (as such terms are defined in the Zoning Resolution) pursuant to Section 93-32 of the Zoning Resolution; and WHEREAS, pursuant to Section 93-32(a) of the Zoning Resolution, Transferor and Transferee have jointly filed an application, designated Application No. N150451 by certification, the distribution of one hundred fourteen thousand four hundred thirteen and eighty-five hundredths (114,413.85) square feet of floor area from the Granting Site to the Receiving Site, thus reducing the maximum Floor Area permitted on the Granting Site from one hundred seventy thousand six hundred eleven and seventy-four hundredths (170,611.74) square feet to fifty-six thousand one hundred ninety-seven and eighty-nine hundredths (56,197.89) square feet and increasing the maximum Floor Area permitted on the Receiving Site from four hundred eight thousand ninety-four and twenty hundredths (408,094.20) square feet.to five hundred twenty-two thousand five hundred eight and five hundredths (522,508.05) square feet; and WHEREAS, in connection with and as a condition to the CPC Chairperson's certification of the 93-32 Application, Transferor and Transferee are required to file this Transfer and Distribution Instrument with the Office of the Register of City of New York, New York County (the“City Register's Office"). NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreement herein contained, it is hereby agreed as follows: 1.
